answer_1.quote: we propose a new task, namely patent claim revision, aiming at improving the quality of patent claims to pass the legal scrutiny of patent offices.

answer_2.quote: We use the standard metrics for text revision, including SARI, BLEU, ROUGE-L (R-L), BERTScore.

answer_3.quote: Thus, we use GPT-4 with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting to evaluate generated patent claims, namely G-Eval. GPT-4 is given the human evaluation criteria, claims being evaluated, and reference claims. We ask GPT-4 to evaluate the given claims step-by-step and assign a score for each criterion.

answer_4.quote: To enhance the precision of evaluation for this new task, we incorporate evaluations by patent professionals, adhering strictly to established examination criteria. ... rating each on the aforementioned criteria on a scale from 1 to 10.
answer_4.guideline: Patent professionals rated claims based on criteria including Completeness of Essential Features, Conceptual Clarity, Consistency in Terminology, and Technical Accuracy of Feature Linkages.
